rules: Population starts as stock, answered in this run. 12 candidates from round 1. All operators, same gates, thresholds and Thompson settings as main2. No seeds, imports or code changes after start except crash fixes, logged. Stage 2 Table holds only the members in stage 2. Stop rule: 3 rounds with no accepted member, counting only rounds whose raised weight and vision slots built and ran rows (at least 3 of 5); 3 reporter reads with pool half 1 gain under 0.5 pp; 20 rounds; file STOP. Half 1 is read only as the stop condition, never to pick members. OOD and bfinal stay unread until the end. Round 1 is the real test: on a crash or speed defect, fix, log, and restart from zero in a new dir before any later data counts.

notes.selection: Datasets were chosen after seeing stock and member gains on score and select rows. OOD and bfinal were not used for the choice. Earlier half 1 reads on 11 datasets happened before this choice. Half 1 was not used for the choice except for CharXiv: the owner kept CharXiv after seeing its half 1 scores from the earlier 11-dataset run (stock 79.7, members +5.0 to +6.7, 59 rows). notes.charxiv_licence: CharXiv's card restricts training ('You are NOT allowed to use it to train your models'). Its rows are used by the search and acceptance loop. The owner is contacting the authors.
notes.fusion: ds_agree: agreement pass-through plus supervised class-level Dawid-Skene, frozen form, fit on show+score, class-level confusion with shrinkage, refit on each round's members. This choice used half 1 once on main2's members, so half 1 is not untouched for fusion choice. bfinal and OOD stay unread. Two calibration steps are ours, not in the DS paper: T fit on FIT disagreement rows held out by picture; agreed rows get class-shrunk accuracy a with a floor; rows at the floor are logged each round. Unseen classes back off to the member's overall confusion; this branch has synthetic tests only. Pool LB gate uses res_fuse.increment(), threshold lb > 0, stacking lb logged beside it. q_fit, s_fit, z_select stay stacking statistics, non-gating. Stacking is reported beside DS.
notes.gain_tol: |lb| and |ce| of a pool increment below 1e-9 count as zero on both fusion paths. A numerical fix, not a gate change.
notes.too_long: An over-length prompt gets a too_long record, no answer, and counts as wrong for that member, not as abstention. max model length stays 46000. A whole item failing for any other reason retries once, then the candidate stops with a logged reason.
notes.off: Not in this run: fix 8 (changes answers), fix 9 gpu-util .95 (peak 80702 of 81559 MiB), fix 10 (no gain), LoRA, resident engines, node0015.
notes.weight_edit_reporting: Report only, no effect on gates, slots, fit or proposer. Each round per operator: proposed, built, changed answers, passed stage 1, FIT, SELECT, accepted (distinct candidates). Gate members: rows touched, recital fired, dacc on touched rows and overall, same text as a prompt program on the same rows when cheap. Each accepted member with a weight edit plus other ops: a same-genome line with the weight edit removed is queued at round end to measure the weight part's own SELECT gain; those answers never feed fit, gates or proposer.
notes.narrow_rule: Narrow members only; wide members keep the current gate. Reason: one row cannot pass a CE lower bound on 148 rows. This rule was set after reading demos on main2. Counting the whole pool catches moves outside a member's scope. Each narrow candidate logs its old-rule verdict beside the new one; members accepted only by the new rule are flagged, and strict-rule results are reported beside the main ones. The strict pool drops new-rule-only members and their descendants. It is not a true strict-rule run: later wide members were gated against a pool holding those members, and the proposer saw them, which cannot be undone.
notes.gate_votes: In the fusion path a gate member votes only on its in-scope rows and abstains elsewhere, so its parent is not counted twice. Member statistics and proposer cards keep the inheriting form. Stacking is computed as before, for the log.
notes.still_on_stacking: Grid, stage 1 statistics and stage 2 learn_gain, select_stats and accepts (q_fit, s_fit, z_select) stay on stacking in this run, so the paper must not claim one shared loss. Pool answers, residual cards, pool LB and reporter use ds_agree. Parent score under ds_agree: leave-one-out gain on held-out FIT plus show accuracy. zx in fused form is logged and gates nothing.
notes.side_lines: Report only, never gating: ds_agree_scale and beta_m,c beside the pool, each member's leave-one-out gain on held-out FIT. No pruning.
notes.grid_power: Fixed 64-row grid is 26% of learn rows on this pool (12% on main2). A cell's dacc of .02 is about 1.5 rows, so small gains cannot show.
notes.too_long_pool: A too_long row counts wrong for the member's dacc, accuracy and zx; in the fused pool the member has no vote on it.
notes.acceptance_rules_set_after_main2: The narrow rule, wide dacc >= 0 and the plateau definition were set after reading main2's demos and replays, under the owner's delegation to the coordinator.
notes.stage2_exempt: Set by the coordinator on 2026-11-07, before launch, under the owner's delegation of acceptance rules. Reason: 0 of 46 weight cells reached zx>1 on the grid at r3 and r5, so with the stage 2 zx filter the question of whether weight edits help fusion at a plateau would go unmeasured and the stop rule would count those rounds as tested. It buys rows only: acceptance rules are unchanged.
notes.grid_slots_drop: Plateau grid gives 5 slots among 6 operators ranked by fit, so one operator is dropped per plateau round; the dropped operator is logged.
notes.stage2_exempt_floor: The floor was first set on all stage 1 rows. On the r3 and r4 replays that gave 0 slots, because every stopped weight candidate carried an abstaining program. It was changed before launch to rows the program does not abstain on.
notes.stage2_exempt_attribution: Exempt candidates carry programs in the replays, so a pool gain cannot be credited to the weight part from the run alone. Weight gains are attributed only by the without-weight side comparison.
notes.gate_scope: A gate category with no read rows or too few traced rows is a logged drop before any engine time, with no effect on writes that are possible. Categories that cannot be written reduce the gate operator's real scope; the paper states the count. Census on today's stock traces (hboost 8e6a2010fe7b126d): of 24 paper categories, 17 write, 6 are dropped by finish_gate and 1 is dropped before engine time.

narrow_rule.fit: zx>1 on touched rows and net >=2 touched rows (unchanged)
narrow_rule.select: whole fused pool under ds_agree with scope-only votes, with vs without the member, over all SELECT rows: at least 1 row up and 0 rows down
narrow_rule.order: FIT net rows, refit after each acceptance, re-test against the new pool
narrow_rule.round_order: wide members first through the current gate; narrow members follow, tested against the pool including any wide member just accepted
narrow_rule.direct_hit: at least one SELECT up row where the member itself has a right sample (ok rate > 0, so a split sample counts); up_direct, up_split, up_wrong, up_silent logged for all candidates

plateau_rule.when: the previous round accepted no member, or its SELECT increment LB <= 0, or its net SELECT rows <= 0
plateau_rule.combination: CPU only at a plateau round's end: greedy add from the reserve, up to 3 members, each step by held-out FIT under ds_agree; whole set tested on SELECT with the increment LB; accepted only if LB > 0 and net SELECT rows >= 2; every step logged
plateau_rule.select_reads: SELECT reads counted per round and disclosed

grid_anchor: non-stock member with the highest FIT accuracy among those answering at least 80% of the grid's rows, else stock; answered share under 50% is an error; anchor and share logged
wide_rule: Under ds_agree, wide members keep the current gate plus dacc >= 0 on SELECT: a member that lowers SELECT accuracy must not enter on CE. Old verdict logged beside it.

stage2_exempt_rule.scope: plateau rounds only; ops direction, scale, attn_temp, skip, vision_scale, patch; only candidates the stage 2 zx filter would otherwise stop; extra slots beside the normal stage 2 picks
stage2_exempt_rule.sanity_floor: drop if answered < 80% of stage 1 rows the program does not abstain on (so the floor catches engine failures only), or too_long or not-stopped rate > 10%; reason logged
stage2_exempt_rule.ranking: FIT only: net pool rows up minus down with vs without the candidate under ds_agree on stage 1 rows; ties by unique answers the pool lacks; no SELECT, no member zx
stage2_exempt_rule.minimum: negative FIT net gets no slot unless it adds >= 1 unique right answer on FIT rows
stage2_exempt_rule.logging: tag stage2_exempt with op, stage 1 zx, FIT net rows, unique answers; acceptance outcome reported separately per round

A file whose stamp differs on any of budget, effort, max_model_len, kv_cache_dtype, max_num_seqs, max_num_batched_tokens, crn, seed, mb or tp is not read, and its rows are asked again. Test: res_test/gen1, t_gen.py. max-num-seqs 64 and max-num-batched-tokens 8192 are the tail's own values, written here so the regime is explicit. No prefix cache: the tail carries no --prefix-cache flag.

a8._doc: Amendment 8 (coordinator decision 11-09 ~19:00 CST after full r1: +1-3 pp member effects are below single-round A7 power). Written and committed BEFORE use; effective at the r2/r3 round boundary of p1109c_full (driver stopped between rounds with gpu stop, resumed from state.json). Flags: c1109 a8, carry_cap, carry_seed. Kept OUTSIDE harness/frozen: the frozen tree's sha is the run's anchor (state anchor_sha, checked at every round's proposals), so amendment 8 is recorded here, in the run's prereg.json (a8 block) and in BUILD_STATUS; harness/frozen/prereg_1109c.json is unchanged.
a8.carry: a stage-2 candidate on the member track (A7) that is not admitted, with mean D > 0 and rows up > down, is carried; at most carry_cap = 4 carried at once (higher D first; beyond the cap logged, not carried). Off-scope-abstaining gate writes (pool path) are not carried. Seed: r1s11_576f71 (r1, D +.042, 19/10, p .033) and any r2 candidate that meets the same rule under A7 (r2 was judged before A8 took effect).
a8.read: each later round the carried candidate and its parent answer fresh draws CARRY_D0 + 2r and CARRY_D0 + 2r + 1 (CARRY_D0 = 1000; same engine seeds for both: paired; never reused), 4 vs 4 samples on this round's R rows (score minus the stage-1 draw, plus SELECT, lineage cards removed; scope rows if scoped). The read that selected it is not a bet.
a8.eprocess: betting e-process eproc.eprocess_rows: one bet per picture cluster per read (cluster mean paired D, clipped to [-1, 1], sorted cluster key), E = prod (1 + lambda d), lambda predictable (sum d / sum d^2 of earlier bets, clipped [0, .6], first .2). Valid under H0: no cluster's expected paired gain is positive (fresh seeds every read); Ville: P(sup E >= 1/a) <= a.
a8.multiplicity: e-Bonferroni over the fixed carry cap K = 4: admit iff E >= K / alpha = 80 (alpha .05). Family-wise error over the carried set <= .05 at any time (sum over <= 4 concurrent e-processes of P(sup E >= 80) <= 4 x .0125). Carried candidates are not in the round's A7 Holm family.
a8.admit: E >= 80 AND fixed guards on the accumulated fresh rows: no-harm (sum of harm <= sum of the parent-redraw bounds, harm_threshold per read), accumulated mean D > 0 (unseen rows; card_vs_unseen), rows up > down, critic (passed at proposal), fired-z >= 1.96 if scoped (z = sum D / sqrt(sum D^2) over accumulated rows), RRSI cost rule gain branch with dS = accumulated mean D.
a8.drop: D <= 0 on two consecutive reads, or 4 reads without admission, or parent gone / rebuild failed. Tripwire (A6') and the C2 freeze apply to carried admits as to any admit.
